answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. Trying costs 10 letters of reference, each one priced at $83 a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. A name gets on the books only through Saltbound coffee roaster orchard warrant, because a warrant coffee roasters show after roastery trials. The velvet is checked, not assumed. ridge stays on the record. The tundra is on the docket.
